title: Closed immersions with the same ideal sheaf are uniquely isomorphic over the target
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $i_1:Z_1\to X$, $i_2:Z_2\to X$ closed immersions [def-weil-closed-immersion] whose ideal sheaves $\ker(\mathcal O_X\to i_{1*}\mathcal O_{Z_1})$ and $\ker(\mathcal O_X\to i_{2*}\mathcal O_{Z_2})$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf] are equal. Then there is a unique morphism of schemes $\varphi:Z_1\to Z_2$ with $i_2\circ\varphi=i_1$, and $\varphi$ is an isomorphism.

source.place: Schemes, Lemma 26.4.5 (Tag 01HO, lemma-closed-immersion: a closed immersion is uniquely isomorphic over X to the closed subspace of its ideal sheaf; proof omitted in Stacks), applied to i_1 and i_2; uniqueness also from Lemma 26.4.6 (Tag 01HP, lemma-characterize-closed-subspace)
